descriptions.en: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
descriptions.zh: 当 Lavos 转化战场时， 他的蛇鼓励着他。他使用毒素、冰冻、电击和火焰来造成元素伤害。掌控黑暗炼金术士的力量。

descriptions.en: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others ascended. Lavos, the master of transmutation, bowed to no one as he forged his own path to valor.
descriptions.zh: 当其他战甲还在逐步提升时，有些战甲生来就是 Prime 的。Lavos 是炼制术大师，他从不向任何人低头，而是开辟了自己的英勇之路。

descriptions.en: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
descriptions.zh: Loki伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

descriptions.en: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.
descriptions.zh: 利用反物质。 Nova 使用反物质粒子来提供群体控制并放大伤害输出。她通过使物质不稳定来消灭敌人。

descriptions.en: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 发射一颗大型充能反物质粒子，触碰即引爆。通过瞄准来控制粒子方向，射击以进一步充能。造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害，并必定造成异常状态。

descriptions.en: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
descriptions.zh: 使用不稳定的反物质对一个不断扩大的范围内的所有敌人进行填充。按下技能键可减缓敌人移动速度，长按则加快其移动速度。

descriptions.en: Nova Prime wreaks devastation on her enemies using volatile antimatter. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Nova Prime 以她的反物质能量波来对敌人造成破坏。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
descriptions.zh: 创造反物质粒子环绕 Nova 四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对 Nova 的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。

descriptions.en: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
descriptions.zh: 创造一个虫洞以实现瞬间移动。长按此技能可预览放置位置。

descriptions.en: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
descriptions.zh: 在指定区域中制造出一阵局部轰炸风暴。

descriptions.en: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
descriptions.zh: 发射出一枚能造成大规模爆炸的慢速导弹。

descriptions.en: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ELYTRON）这种重型曲翼只为了一个目的而被设计出来：破坏。

descriptions.en: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
descriptions.zh: 将曲翼推进器核心中的气体排出，混淆并使敌方导弹引爆。

descriptions.en: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
descriptions.zh: 发射出一枚可附着在目标上并遥控引爆的高效爆裂物。

descriptions.en: This enhanced version of the first Archwing prototype takes the design to its theoretical limits.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ODONATA PRIME）第一架曲翼原型的强化机型，已将其设计为到理论上的极限状态。

descriptions.en: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
descriptions.zh: 战甲放出巨大的能量脉冲，晕眩并击飞附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
descriptions.zh: 形成一个围绕并保护着战甲的能量护罩。

descriptions.en: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
descriptions.zh: 放出可以混淆敌方导弹接近的热诱弹。

descriptions.en: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
descriptions.zh: 连续发射大量导弹。

descriptions.en: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ODONATA）这组曲翼的系统拥有均衡的攻防能力。

descriptions.en: The Itzal Archwing teleports a short distance, dropping all enemy target locks.
descriptions.zh: 刺影曲翼瞬移一小段距离，尽数甩开锁定了目标的敌人。

descriptions.en: Activates a cloaking field that hides the Warframe and any nearby allies who remain stationary.
descriptions.zh: 展开一道隐形力场，使静止于力场中的战甲与友军隐匿行踪。

descriptions.en: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
descriptions.zh: 部署数台无人战机于战甲身旁进行战斗，当无人战机被破坏时会造成毁灭性的爆炸。

descriptions.en: Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
descriptions.zh: 形成一个会吸进附近所有物体的微型黑洞，并在最后爆裂造成大规模的冲击震波。

descriptions.en: Cosmic Crush Augment: The black hole saps the area of heat, freezing enemies in range. Enemies near the black hole are completely frozen for |val|s.
descriptions.zh: 星体震荡强化：黑洞可以削弱范围内的热能并完全冻结附近的敌人 |val| 秒。

descriptions.en: Designed for quick clandestine attacks, the Itzal Archwing excels at striking from the darkness of space.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ITZAL）专为隐匿行动而打造，这架曲翼擅长在太空的黑暗中进行突袭作战。

descriptions.en: Transform into a winged guardian.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AMESHA）化身成一名飞翼守护者。

descriptions.en: Banshee’s call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
descriptions.zh: Banshee 的尖叫预示着死亡。她能够用声波攻击来维持群体控制和识别敌人的弱点。当她的力量袭来，几乎没有人能够站稳脚跟。

descriptions.en: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Banshee Prime 以操控声波力量造成的致死效果攻击敌人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.
descriptions.zh: Banshee 将她所有的声音能量传导至周遭环境，使用超声波反响剧烈撼动目标区域的地面。

descriptions.en: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.
descriptions.zh: Banshee 释放一道音波冲击波，将范围内的敌人击退，使其失去战斗力并降低他们的护甲。

descriptions.en: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
descriptions.zh: 使用静音会使 Banshee 笼罩在一层光环之中，该光环会眩晕敌人，限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的感知及战术反应，并使他们无法激活自身的技能。

descriptions.en: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.
descriptions.zh: Banshee 的声纳技能可以利用声波进行定位，借以侦测及追踪敌人，并使队伍成员发觉敌人身上暴露出的致命弱点。

descriptions.en: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.
descriptions.zh: Octavia 将低音、节奏和旋律编成一首毁灭的赞歌。她的曼达和弦琴音乐让她具备高度的生存能力和支援友军的能力。她谱写的歌意味着敌人的毁灭。

descriptions.en: Strike up a symphony of destruction with the mistress of music, Octavia, in her grandest and most spectacular form. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 女音乐家 Octavia，以其卓绝华美的形态，演奏毁灭的乐章。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 被改造成一个动机强烈且令人恐惧的杀手。她善于造成伤害和生存下去。她的战吼让所有听到它的人感到恐惧。

descriptions.en: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 发射钩索，将自己拉向命中的目标点。如果钩索命中敌人，则附近的敌人也会被拉向目标点，同时 Valkyr 会发动一次连携近战攻击。

descriptions.en: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。

descriptions.en: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 露出致命的利爪，释放毁灭性攻击的同时治疗自身。Valkyr 在使用利爪时免疫异常状态，且通过咆哮获得的护甲翻倍。

descriptions.en: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道破坏性的冲击波使敌人减速，并使其受到的近战伤害增加。

descriptions.en: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 一位经历了时间与伤痛的洗礼后依然毫发无损的高傲斗士。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.
descriptions.zh: 在往事如烟的时代，据说山脉是战士的容身之所。在这个时代，山脉已化身成战士。

descriptions.en: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
descriptions.zh: 在这个拳头坚硬如石头的搏击者面前，敌人瑟瑟发抖。Atlas 可以造成高额的伤害。掌控构筑战场基石的大地之力。

descriptions.en: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
descriptions.zh: 漂浮在虚空中的破碎战甲汇聚在一起，形成了 Xaku。他们齐心协力，造成高额的伤害。Xaku 证明了合力的力量胜过单独的力量。

descriptions.en: The child of war and void is reborn in gold. That which was once shattered may rise stronger than that which was never broken.
descriptions.zh: 战争与虚空之子在黄金中重生。曾经破碎过的东西可能会比从未破碎过的东西更强大。

descriptions.en: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
descriptions.zh: 沉醉于毁灭之歌。通过她，翠玉之光可以成为毁灭之力，也可以成为支持之源。

descriptions.en: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.
descriptions.zh: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计 Qorvex，是为了防止被选中的指挥官受到其实验室中特殊风险的危害。堆芯赋予了 Qorvex 群体控制的能力，从而使其具有强大的生存能力。

descriptions.en: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
descriptions.zh: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。

descriptions.en: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
descriptions.zh: 枪手往往有一双稳定的死神之手。她每次射击都会造成高额伤害。Mesa 是该领域最快的拔枪手。

descriptions.en: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
descriptions.zh: 在极度的专注之下，Mesa 以她的监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。

descriptions.en: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 通过这名致命的执法者投射一道长影。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
descriptions.zh: Mesa 笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。

descriptions.en: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
descriptions.zh: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。

descriptions.en: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
descriptions.zh: 永远不要低估忧怨带来的力量和怒火。Dagath 的怨恨会造成很高的伤害。

descriptions.en: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
descriptions.zh: 以 Xata 异端者的身份战斗，意味着背后有恶魔相助。Uriel 用灼热的硫磺焚烧敌人，并召唤三个邪恶仆从为他效力。

descriptions.en: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.
descriptions.zh: Grendel 将每个战场都视为大杂烩。他贪得无厌的胃口使他具有很高的生存能力。敌人会被吃掉，然后被吐出。

descriptions.en: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.
descriptions.zh: 原始。永不饱足。Grendel Prime 吞食所有反抗他的人。

descriptions.en: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 与元素紧密结合并发动无尽毁灭之力的 Chroma Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
descriptions.zh: 释放龙之力量。Chroma 使用火焰、电击、毒素和冰冻元素来造成高伤害，同时保持生存能力。以愤怒为翼，翱翔吧。
Narin 如旋涡般降临，她的利刃锋利无比，如同凛冽的寒风。她能巧妙地运用冰霜防御，如同她迅捷的细剑攻击一般。

descriptions.en: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.
descriptions.zh: 操纵烈焰之力。Ember 的火焰会造成很高的伤害。即使战斗进入白热化时，她仍能保持冷静的头脑。

descriptions.en: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Ember Prime 具有像 Ember 一样肆意破坏的潜力，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
descriptions.zh: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。

descriptions.en: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
descriptions.zh: 猛击地面以产生一道焚化的等离子波来将敌人击退并剥去他们的护甲。

descriptions.en: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
descriptions.zh: 施放强力助燃可以眩晕邻近敌人，并提升对其造成的火焰伤害。

descriptions.en: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
descriptions.zh: 用猛火爆发燃烧附近的敌人，并随之用一连串的火球打击胆敢靠近的敌人。随着时间的推移，火球将燃烧得更猛烈，也消耗更多能量。

descriptions.en: Nothing fancy but gets the job done and then some. With its electrified armor, this rough and ready mech can make the battlefield treacherous for the enemy with an arsenal of explosives.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VOIDRIG）虽然外表不怎么光鲜亮丽，但却能出色地完成工作。凭借其电能护甲，这款粗糙且整装待发的机甲能够携带大量爆炸物，让战场上的敌人陷入苦战。

descriptions.en: This fearsome Necramech, fashioned in honor of the Entrati matriarch, is a robust front-line fighter. Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BONEWIDOW）这架慑人的殁世机甲，是为了纪念英择谛的女族长而设计的，这是一个强健的前线战士。相较于护盾强度，骨骸寡妇在护甲和生命值上更占优势。她可以抓起敌人并将其猛掷出去，或是部署一个重型盾牌来进行个人防御，又或是以巨大的战刃在敌军中杀出一条血路。

descriptions.en: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
descriptions.zh: 来自长夜暗影中的新型 Excalibur。

descriptions.en: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.
descriptions.zh: Excalibur 是战士精神的缩影。他炉火纯青的剑术可造成高额伤害。他是卓越武学的化身。

descriptions.en: Excalibur Prime is the epitome of mobility and offense, and features the same abilities as Excalibur, but has unique mod polarities installed allowing for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Excalibur Prime 是机动性与攻击性的象征，并拥有与 Excalibur 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
descriptions.zh: 来自长夜暗影中的新型 Excalibur。

descriptions.en: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道明亮的闪光，致盲附近所有的敌人。

descriptions.en: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 发射广域标枪刺穿附近的敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptions.zh: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Excalibur launches into the air, jumping 3x higher than normal.
descriptions.zh: Excalibur 向上弹射到空中，其跳跃高度是一般跳跃的三倍。

descriptions.en: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
descriptions.zh: Titania 仙女般的外表掩盖了她强大的统治力量。这个女魔法师可造成高额伤害并对敌人实施群体控制。她会迫使对手向她致敬，否则就会灭亡。

descriptions.en: Tempting and terrifying, this is Titania in her ultimate form.
descriptions.zh: 诱人而又令人恐惧，这就是 Titania 的终极形态。

descriptions.en: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
descriptions.zh: 唤来变化莫测的雪崩，瞬间冻结并粉碎范围内的所有敌人。

descriptions.en: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost’s attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.
descriptions.zh: 当 Frost 踏上战场时，敌人会感到一阵寒意。 Frost 的攻击可以提供群体控制、保护目标，并提高生存力。驾驭刺骨的冰雪之力。

descriptions.en: Frost Prime has the same chilling abilities as Frost but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Frost Prime 拥有与 Frost 一样的急冻技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
descriptions.zh: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。

descriptions.en: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
descriptions.zh: 制造一道由锋利冰晶构成的冰浪来对敌人造成大量伤害及缓速效果。

descriptions.en: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道极度低温的能量来冻结目标。

descriptions.en: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.
descriptions.zh: 身随影动，强势出击。奥罗金创造了一款结合了伤害和隐身的战甲用于解决掉一些敏感问题，但他在奥罗金灭亡的混乱之中消失了。只剩下一个批次名称：Cyte-09。

descriptions.en: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
descriptions.zh: 血之女王磨砺着她的利爪。Garuda 以敌人的血液为武器，造成高额伤害。血色的美丽与她致命的力量相得益彰。

descriptions.en: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.
descriptions.zh: 纯白、耀金与至深猩红，血腥女王盛装登场。
水晶堡垒拔地而起。Citrine Prime 散发着令人着迷的夺目光彩，她那璀璨的宝石镶嵌在精美的金丝花纹中。

descriptions.en: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
descriptions.zh: 凝视这位水晶卫士。Citrine 的水晶可以在战场上支持盟友。战斗只会增强她的分形之美。

descriptions.en: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.
descriptions.zh: 身披玻璃铠甲，继承传奇战士 Gara 的遗志。用水晶的纯净力量统治战场。

descriptions.en: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
descriptions.zh: Gara 以致命之触让敌人变成易碎之物。Gara 的玻璃技能为她和她的友军提供了生存能力，同时能造成高伤害。粉碎敌人。

descriptions.en: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.
descriptions.zh: 通过带电线圈与发射器的传导性来消灭敌人，Gyre 的电击可对敌人施加群体控制。她是优雅理论的化身。

descriptions.en: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.
descriptions.zh: 镀金电路闪烁着能量，驱动着穿越时空的狂乱舞步。与 Gyre Prime 一起舞向永恒。

descriptions.en: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
descriptions.zh: Mirage 的戏法与她的实力相得益彰。被她搞得晕头转向的敌人会受到严重伤害。分身、激光和陷阱是她舞台艺术的要素。

descriptions.en: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
descriptions.zh: Mirage 创造随行的分身以混淆视听并引开敌人。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
descriptions.zh:
（短按）暂时减少敌人对 Mirage 造成的伤害。
（长按）暂时增加 Mirage 的武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Dazzle the opposition with this golden master of illusion and mayhem. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 用这位精通幻术和破坏的金色大师来扰乱对手吧。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
descriptions.zh: 将附近物品变成诡雷的同时变出一个令敌人难以抗拒的宝石。在黑暗处触碰宝石会爆裂造成范围致盲，在光亮处则产生范围爆炸。通过镜厅的帮助能施放出数个小宝石。

descriptions.en: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
descriptions.zh: 放出一个四处发射激光的能量球。再次激活此技能可以引爆炸弹，并致盲附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
descriptions.zh: Styanax 从不去想他要面对多少敌人，他只在乎能在何处找到他们。重装步兵可造成高额伤害。在他的长矛和盾牌的威力下，敌人闻风丧胆。

descriptions.en: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.
descriptions.zh: 无罪之盾，正义之矛。Styanax Prime 坚守阵线，对抗暴政。

descriptions.en: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
descriptions.zh: Nidus 从感染者中获得力量，以此造成高伤害和提供群体控制，增强了其生存能力。给你的敌人带来瘟疫吧。

descriptions.en: Mutation is endless. The ravening plague-bearer returns in a long-unseen form, seething with a primal strain of the Infestation.
descriptions.zh: 永无止境的突变。贪婪的瘟疫之源以远古之形带着原始感染菌株咆哮而来。

descriptions.en: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
descriptions.zh: 欢愉而可怕的绘影者 Follie 赋予墨水生命。她能通过千变万化的素描与戏法来支援小队，并控制敌群。

descriptions.en: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
descriptions.zh: 强韧就是 Hildryn 的长处。Hildryn 可从吸收自身护盾以提供能量给技能所用，同时能量亦可再次充能护盾。Hildryn 证明了优秀的进攻就是最佳的防守。

descriptions.en: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.
descriptions.zh: Hildryn Prime 证明了权力是纪律的回报。

descriptions.en: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。

descriptions.en: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给 Nyx。

descriptions.en: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 的精神攻击使她成为一个危险的对手。她通过触及敌人的意识来进行群体控制，并将他们的攻击转向他们自己。这种操纵可以扭转战局。

descriptions.en: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 控制目标的思想，迫使他们为 Tenno 效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当 Nyx 射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。

descriptions.en: Infiltrate the minds of your enemies with Nyx Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 通过 Nyx Prime 来渗透进敌人的精神中。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
descriptions.zh: Khora 有着血染的鞭子和爪子。她与她的库娃同伴薇娜丽，合力造成高伤害并提供群体控制。双身同心。

descriptions.en: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.
descriptions.zh: 女能手和怪物的默契配合。镀金女猎手与她忠诚的库娃——薇娜丽，以她们的意志统治着战场。

descriptions.en: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
descriptions.zh: 让掷骰巫女试试你的运气。命运编织者 Koumei 攻守兼备。对有德之人，她将带来启示；对奸邪之人，她是一场危险的博弈。

descriptions.en: Decoy
descriptions.zh: 诱饵

descriptions.en: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道能量波，解除范围内敌人的射击武器，迫使他们使用近战。

descriptions.en: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
descriptions.zh: Loki伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

descriptions.en: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
descriptions.zh: Loki 精通欺骗的艺术。恶作剧者利用隐身来袭击敌人。制造混乱吧。

descriptions.en: Confuse, deceive and destroy with Loki Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 混淆、误导与破坏是 Loki Prime 的代名词。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
descriptions.zh: Loki瞬间和目标交换位置，迷惑敌人。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）将目标封闭在磁场中，在一段时间内困住附近的敌人，并对其造成伤害。该磁场会吸引环绕 Mag 运动的「护盾极化碎片」和飞溅的弹片进行致命混合。
（长按）Mag 将自己包裹在一个磁场中，吸收远程攻击，并在一个破坏性锥型域内返还伤害。

descriptions.en: Magnetize the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
descriptions.zh: 磁化附近的敌军的骨头，导致它们自我崩坏。

descriptions.en: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.
descriptions.zh: 运用磁力击倒你的敌人。Mag 通过改变磁场来提供群体控制，同时削减敌人的防御力。几乎无人能抵挡她的吸引力或排斥力。

descriptions.en: The exquisite Mag Prime offers the same abilities as Mag but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 精巧的 Mag Prime 拥有与 Mag 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
descriptions.zh: Mag 所制造出的磁力漩涡会晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。

descriptions.en: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道能量脉冲，在耗尽敌人护盾和护甲的同时恢复队友护盾。脉冲留下的碎片会形成「护盾极化碎片」。附近的「护盾极化碎片」会环绕 Mag 并切割敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道裂隙能量波来伤害敌人，同时将敌人与队友从 Limbo 目前所在的位面中推出去。

descriptions.en: Dance between realms with this golden rift walker. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 用这金色的裂隙行者起舞于不同的领域。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
descriptions.zh: 他掌握着影子与物质之间的裂隙。 Limbo 通过扰乱时空来进行群体控制。这是他的主场，其余人都将沉沦于虚实之间。

descriptions.en: Pass over into the rift plane.
descriptions.zh: 遁入裂隙位面。

descriptions.en: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
descriptions.zh: 借由虚空能量的猛烈爆炸撕开一个裂隙位面空间，此空间能短暂持续至下一次致命爆炸发生。

descriptions.en: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
descriptions.zh: 用裂隙能量涌流冲击附近被裂隙困住的敌人。被击杀时裂隙涌流会被传递到涌流外的一名附近的敌人上。被涌流影响的敌人若离开裂隙，将会引起一个范围​​放逐。

descriptions.en: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
descriptions.zh: 猴族战士力拔山兮气盖世。Wukong 能够造成巨大的伤害并具备强大的生存能力。他灵活多变的恶作剧战术让人难忘。

descriptions.en: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.
descriptions.zh: 恶作剧战士提升到了他的最终形态。

descriptions.en: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
descriptions.zh: 召唤战死敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。

descriptions.en: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
descriptions.zh: 有一个收割者，他的名字叫 Nekros。他提供致命的群体控制。当 Nekros 从死者中召唤新兵时，昔日的敌人就会变成盟友。

descriptions.en: Death's new master. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 死亡的新主人。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
descriptions.zh: 亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。

descriptions.en: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
descriptions.zh: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被杀死，他就会成为 Nekros「亡者幽影」中的一员。

descriptions.en: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
descriptions.zh: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。

descriptions.en: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
descriptions.zh: 机敏善变的驭火行家保护无辜者。 Nezha 多面化的战术使他在伤害和提供群体控制时具有很高的生存能力。他的火焰是希望的号角。

descriptions.en: Behold: the Scion of the Burning Wind, now before you in most courtly accoutrement. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 看呐：灼烧之风的后嗣，现在身披最典雅的战袍，出现在你面前。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 以狂乱与诡计成为致命武器的 Ash Prime。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.
descriptions.zh: 看那奥罗金政治刺杀学派的先师圣人。 Ash 擅长潜行。还没见其刀光，就已命归黄泉。

descriptions.en: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
descriptions.zh: 将 Ash 的凶猛影分身投入远处的敌群中。使用「瞬移」可以主动加入这场厮杀。幻影分身可通过 Mod 来升级。

descriptions.en: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时 Ash 进入短暂的隐身状态。

descriptions.en: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
descriptions.zh: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为 Ash 恢复一部分消耗的能量。

descriptions.en: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
descriptions.zh: 和 Nokko 一起行动起来！这位年轻的守护者拥有强大的根系和各种古灵精怪的真菌，很快就会扎根在你的心里

descriptions.en: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
descriptions.zh: Protea 对保护了如指掌。她庞大的武器库可以造成伤害并为友军提供支援。她甚至可以操纵时间本身。

descriptions.en: Behold the child of two fathers. Protea Prime once fulfilled Parvos Granum's vision of a time-wielding guardian. Now she upholds the Tenno ideal of defending the defenseless.
descriptions.zh: 看这位双父之女。Protea Prime 曾实现帕尔沃斯·格拉努关于操纵时间守护者的愿景。现在，她秉承 Tenno 的理念，保护手无寸铁之人。

descriptions.en: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
descriptions.zh: 阴险优雅与致命多面性交织，进化为完美掠食者。恐惧之名，Oraxia。

descriptions.en: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.
descriptions.zh: 那些破坏和平，以及耗尽这位不愿出手的战士克制力的愚蠢之人注定会灭亡。

descriptions.en: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
descriptions.zh: 不可小觑波澜不惊之人心中的怒火。Baruuk 拥有出色的生存能力和群体控制能力。当忍无可忍之时，这位不愿出手的大师就会释放其内在的暴怒。

descriptions.en: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
descriptions.zh: 知识探求者。历史守护者。莱弗博物馆传说的勇敢学者。Dante 创作神秘的诗篇来支援队友并摧毁敌人。

descriptions.en: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
descriptions.zh: 愈合和苦痛皆为 Oberon 所驱使。他对自然界的驾驭能够支援友军。朋友之福，敌人之祸。

descriptions.en: Protect the balance with this regal forest guardian. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 以这帝王般庄严的森林庇护者维系平衡。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.
descriptions.zh: 将附近的敌人迅速举到空中，然后将其狠狠摔下。被该技能击中的会为 Oberon 提供额外护甲，并在死亡时有几率掉落生命球。

descriptions.en: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies’ Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
descriptions.zh: 生成一道保护光环，为 Oberon 及其友军提供护甲加成，并持续恢复友军生命值。在「神圣领域」范围内，治疗效果翻倍。

descriptions.en: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
descriptions.zh: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。

descriptions.en: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
descriptions.zh: 圣化 Oberon 周围的地面，对范围内的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。同时保护 Oberon 及其友军免受异常状态影响。

descriptions.en: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
descriptions.zh: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。

descriptions.en: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
descriptions.zh: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。

descriptions.en: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 以这金银之王号令大海的怒涛。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一只来自深海的生物。它的水之触手从四面八方席卷而来造成严重破坏。

descriptions.en: Become a water trap and drown unsuspecting enemies.
descriptions.zh: 用水漩涡淹没毫无防备的敌人。

descriptions.en: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
descriptions.zh: Hydroid 可以召唤海洋深处的力量。他通过水系攻击来提供群体控制。他的敌人将在水中消亡。

descriptions.en: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
descriptions.zh: 用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。

descriptions.en: Warframe punches the ground, dealing high damage to enemies in a small radius.
descriptions.zh: 战甲震击地面，在小范围内对敌人造成大量伤害。

descriptions.en: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.
descriptions.zh: 永恒的审判官已经崛起，受虚空洗礼，吟诵铁与火的福音。

descriptions.en: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.
descriptions.zh: 通过复仇来实现救赎。僧侣般的 Harrow 会增幅友军的杀伤力，为其提供支援。克敌制胜，超越自我。

descriptions.en: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.
descriptions.zh: 像夜间的树林一样庄严与致命，这就是狩猎女王的终极形态。

descriptions.en: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
descriptions.zh: 女猎手拉动了她的弓箭。 Ivara 善于潜行。她的敌人时刻被她突袭的恐惧所笼罩。

descriptions.en: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.
descriptions.zh: 恐怖的恶灵之力已经涌现。融合了夜灵本质的 Revenant，拥有强大的生存能力和高额伤害。敌人皆成为他的奴仆。

descriptions.en: The lost one rises. Reify the essence of the Eidolon as you wield Revenant Prime’s power.
descriptions.zh: 迷失者之崛起。使用 Revenant Prime 的力量，来具象化夜灵之力。

descriptions.en: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
descriptions.zh: Rhino 硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。

descriptions.en: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
descriptions.zh: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。

descriptions.en: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.
descriptions.zh: Rhino 重拳以待。他拥有很高的生存能力和群体控制技能。当他冲锋时，明智的人都会选择不要站在他的对面。

descriptions.en: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
descriptions.zh: Rhino 向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。

descriptions.en: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 通过将极性插槽改为更适合自定的配置，使 RHINO 地面震动能力发挥到更高水平。

descriptions.en: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
descriptions.zh: Rhino 的强力践踏可以扰乱时间秩序，将周围的敌人锁定在时间中。

descriptions.en: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.
descriptions.zh: 以水银打造的外型。Gauss Prime 不容失败。

descriptions.en: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
descriptions.zh: 与阿尔特拉的圣者一同主宰战场。Gauss 速度快，伤害高，生存能力强。移动可以为他的强大电池充电，因此绝不停下脚步。

descriptions.en: Rise, eternal, to cast the fear of Inaros into them. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这永恒的存在，以此来把 Inaros 带来的恐惧施加到他们身上。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
descriptions.zh: Inaros 统领着骇人的沙漠。他的生存之道如同赋予他力量的千变万化的沙漠。传说中的 Inaros 是恐惧的吞噬者。

descriptions.en: Saryn pollutes the atmosphere with a lethally poisonous mist that corrodes all enemies in range. Deals additional Damage to enemies under <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin and <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral effects.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 以剧毒之雾污染空气，腐蚀范围内的敌人。依据敌人所受到的毒素与病毒影响受到额外伤害。

descriptions.en: Inflicts target with <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage over time. Destroying the spore will spread it to nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 对目标造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> 持续的病毒伤害；摧毁孢子时会扩散至邻近敌人身上。

descriptions.en: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.
descriptions.zh: 剧毒是 Saryn 的强项。她蛇一般的能力会造成巨大伤害。对 Saryn 来说，毒液是一种美德。

descriptions.en: A golden blossom conceals deadly nectar. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 一朵隐藏着致命花蜜的金花。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。

descriptions.en: When active, melee strikes burst spores causing them to spread to nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 施放时，近战攻击会引爆孢子使其扩散到附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.
descriptions.zh: Caliban Prime 是为了庆祝奥罗金与 Sentient 之间短暂的和平而打造的，堪称真正的合璧杰作。双生王国的继承者，身披皇家之金崛起。

descriptions.en: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
descriptions.zh: 双生王国的继承人登场。生物与 Sentient 形态在 Caliban 身上交汇。作为一名老练的君主，他可以对敌人实施群体控制并拥有极强的生存能力。他的创造者心中有不止一个世界。

descriptions.en: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
descriptions.zh: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。Sirius 与 Orion 这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。

descriptions.en: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.
descriptions.zh: 魅力四射的 Temple，手持他的感染吉他：丽兹，用强力的和弦点燃了革命的火焰。

descriptions.en: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
descriptions.zh: 在空中按住技能键，来使 Zephyr 悬停并减慢移动速度。在空中时，轻按技能键来向前冲刺，或是瞄准地面对下方的敌人使出俯冲轰击。

descriptions.en: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
descriptions.zh: 掌控风之力量。Zephyr 的旋风技能可以保护她、造成高伤害并提供群体控制。她从上方俯冲而下，留下一条毁灭之路。

descriptions.en: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
descriptions.zh: 制造致命的「龙卷云风」，四处搜寻并吞没敌人。「龙卷云风」会造成它们所吸收最多的元素伤害类型。射击被吞没的敌人来造成额外伤害。长按制造固定不动的「龙卷云风」，轻按则制造游走的「龙卷云风」。

descriptions.en: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.
descriptions.zh: 围绕Zephyr生成一个风护盾，把所有射进来的子弹都偏转到其他方向。

descriptions.en: Take to the skies with this golden bird of destruction.
descriptions.zh: 用这只富有破坏力的金色小鸟飞向天空。

descriptions.en:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
descriptions.zh:
用精妙的地雷掌控战场。Vauban 的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。

descriptions.en:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.
descriptions.zh:
建立一个包围力场以捕获敌人使他们陷入停滞状态，剥离其护甲并将其转移给 Vauban 和「力场牢狱」范围内的所有友军。

长按技能键来使所有力场牢狱坍塌成为一个破坏性旋涡。

descriptions.en: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
descriptions.zh: 创造一个大规模旋转的能量，猛烈牵引附近敌人，粉碎他们的原子成微小物质。

descriptions.en: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
descriptions.zh: Vauban 是创新技术的典范。他会通过巧妙的部署来对敌人造成群体控制。他的坚韧和专注使他令敌人生畏。

descriptions.en: Transform the battlefield into a weapon with this gilded tactician. Features unique mod polarities for extended customization.
descriptions.zh: 使用这位镀金的战术大师来将战场转变成你的武器吧！该战甲拥有​​着特化过的 MOD 极性槽来提供更佳的自定可能性。

descriptions.en: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
descriptions.zh: 部署一架可以将自身附着在敌人身上的滚子无人机，并向附近区域的任何物体发出炸裂电弧，造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

descriptions.en: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
descriptions.zh: 恢复 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内友军的生命值和护盾，同时减少他们受到的敌人伤害。

descriptions.en: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
descriptions.zh: 友军将在伤害被能力吸取标记的敌人同时获得能量。

descriptions.en: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
descriptions.zh: 链接激活时，一切受到的伤害将转移给身边的一个敌人。

descriptions.en: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.
descriptions.zh: Trinity 体现了救赎与治愈。她非凡的治疗技能可为队友提供强力支持。被他人破坏之处，她可治愈。

descriptions.en: Become the bastion that defends allies using powerful healing abilities with Trinity Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: Trinity Prime 操控强大的治愈能力，成为捍卫友军的壁垒。拥有改造过的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
descriptions.zh: 在敌人身上创造一道生命之井，吸收附近队友受到的异常状态伤害。队友攻击目标时可获得额外生命值。如果队友死亡，生命之井中的敌人将代替他们死亡。

descriptions.en: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.
descriptions.zh: Volt 会释放流淌全身的电流。冲击波会麻痹并伤害附近的敌人。处在冲击波边缘的敌人则会被击晕。

descriptions.en:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.
descriptions.zh:
Volt 部署一个电力屏障，能阻挡敌方火力，并对投射物附加<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。
 
长按可装备屏障，作为移动掩护。

descriptions.en: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。

descriptions.en: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
descriptions.zh: 显现一支电流。Volt 与其队友会获得短暂的移动速度和装填速度增益。

descriptions.en: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
descriptions.zh: 电流在 Volt 身上涌动。他的攻击可造成高额伤害，并震慑敌人。

descriptions.en: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
descriptions.zh: 一位来自过去的荣耀战士，Volt Prime 拥有与 Volt 一样的技能，但自带独特的 Mod 极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。

descriptions.en: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.
descriptions.zh: 辉煌与凶猛在 Voruna Prime 身上达到了顶峰。虽然她被奥罗金黄金所装饰，却比以往任何时候都更具野性。

descriptions.en: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
descriptions.zh: 四头野兽，同心一颗。Voruna 的忠诚狼群是力量与隐秘的致命结合。当心那伴随着可怕嚎叫的复仇獠牙。

descriptions.en: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
descriptions.zh: Wisp 游走于物质和虚无之间。她可以进入多个维度，为友军提供支援。她的面容神秘莫测，让人捉摸不透。

descriptions.en: Wisp Prime’s gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.
descriptions.zh: Wisp Prime 的镀金光彩萦绕在战场上。盟友也十分期待她的多维美貌。

descriptions.en: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.
descriptions.zh: 镀金舵手从暴风雨中现身，他的身影吸引着注定悲怆的灵魂。

descriptions.en: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
descriptions.zh: Sevagoth 不再漂泊虚空，已经回归。他和他的幽影能够造成巨大的伤害，并具有极强的生存能力。他们通过收割那些迷途的灵魂来维持自身的力量。

descriptions.en: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
descriptions.zh: 驭浪者可以在战场上释放出毁灭的洪流。Yareli 的水系攻击可对敌人造成高额伤害。驭浪而上，敌军溺亡。

descriptions.en: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.
descriptions.zh: 驭浪者从海浪中重生。她以奥罗金时代的风采，体现出青春不朽的活力。

descriptions.en: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.
descriptions.zh: 昼夜的最终平衡形态；行走于界线上的优美之型。

descriptions.en: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
descriptions.zh: Equinox 从白昼与黑夜的边缘崛起。她的白昼形态提供攻击支援，她的黑夜形态提供防御支援。她在白昼与黑夜之间来回游走。

descriptions.en: The kubrow sniffs out buried objects and digs them up.
descriptions.zh: 库狛嗅出被埋藏的道具并挖掘出来。

descriptions.en: Fires volleys of icy grenades that inflict a lingering chill on the blast zone.
descriptions.zh: （英文：CRYOTRA）发射一连串冰冷的手榴弹，在爆炸区域留下持久的寒气。

descriptions.en: Launches a volley of bomb darts that embed themselves in targets, exploding a short time later.
descriptions.zh: （英文：MULTRON）发射一连串炸弹飞镖，嵌入目标中并在短时间后爆炸。

descriptions.en: Launches a swarm of micro-missiles.
descriptions.zh: （英文：HELSTRUM）发射密集的微型导弹。

descriptions.en: Releases a burst of static electricity that can jump between foes, incapacitating them.
descriptions.zh: （英文：TAZICOR）释放出一阵静电，该静电可以在敌人之间跳跃，使他们失去战斗能力。

descriptions.en: Charges up a powerful blast of ultra-heated plasma.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VULCAX）可蓄能发射出强力爆发的极热电浆。

descriptions.en: Hound melee attacks pierce hard with <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact and <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BATOTEN）猎犬近战攻击通过 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击和 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害猛烈穿刺。

descriptions.en: Hound melee attacks devastate with <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact and <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LACERTEN）猎犬近战攻击通过 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击和 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害进行毁灭。

descriptions.en: Hound melee attacks eviscerate with <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture and <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AKATEN）猎犬近战攻击通过 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺和 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害开膛剖腹。

descriptions.en: Teshin’s twin blades. Power Strike sends forth two arcs of energy that inflict <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SUN & MOON）Teshin 的双侍刃。使用强力攻击可发出两道造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的爆炸性能量弧。

descriptions.en: Teshin's twin blades.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SUN & MOON）Teshin 的双侍刃。

descriptions.en: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
descriptions.zh: 电气浮囊会电击附近的敌人，并针对远处的威胁目标进行攻击。使用「金工火枪」狙击步枪与「精算射击」、「电弧线圈」与「电光脉冲」等独特技能。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「弹药储转箱」为预设指令，搬运者是一个前锋守护，并配备一把霰弹枪。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」为预设指令，死亡魔方就像广告宣传的那样，是一个带来死亡的超棒魔方，内置死亡机枪。

descriptions.en: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
descriptions.zh: 以「万用自修」和「防线封锁」为默认指令，这件守护是搭乘航道星舰远航的理想同伴。

descriptions.en: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
descriptions.zh: 以「重击者」和「致命诱惑」为预设指令，引灵是一个战斗守护，还配备了毒镖武器。

descriptions.en: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
descriptions.zh: 赫利俄斯拥有独特的「侦查」指令并以「分离」作为武器，这位多功能的守护既是致命的守护者，又是资料库的自动扫描器。扫描功能须在身上携带扫描器，且扫描器有可使用的扫描次数才能触发。

descriptions.en: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NAUTILUS PRIME）这位勇敢的水手使用冰凇 Prime 来保护他的船员。

descriptions.en: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
descriptions.zh: 这架华丽的守护是呈现奥罗金晚期工艺与风格极佳的范例。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」作为预设指令，死亡魔方 Prime 是致命支援的巅峰。其标配武器为死亡机枪 Prime。

descriptions.en: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
descriptions.zh: 这个充满求知欲的守护与分离 Prime 一同防卫着它们的主人。

descriptions.en: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
descriptions.zh: 阴影 Prime 专长隐形，它装载了激光点发 Prime。和它一同主宰暗影吧。

descriptions.en: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.
descriptions.zh: 保镖与地位的象征，在奥罗金时代中，蛟龙守护 Prime 是高阶Tenno 的最后一道防线。

descriptions.en: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?
descriptions.zh: 虚空中的一种稀有珍宝。怎有如此美丽宝物竟是为潜行锻造？

descriptions.en: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
descriptions.zh: 以「扫描水生生命体」和「扫描物质」为默认指令，奥克绪罗斯被设计用于奥布山谷外围严酷环境的搜救行动。奥克绪罗斯拥有一把多连穿甲枪。

descriptions.en: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.
descriptions.zh: 以「复仇」和「幽灵」为预设指令，非常适合隐匿型玩法，并同时具备点放式激光手枪。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「分子转化」为预设指令，塔克桑利用护盾恢复来保护主人。它装备了阿塔克斯冰冷光束。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「群体击散」为预设指令，是强力进攻型的守护，并同时具备激光步枪。

descriptions.en: Upon completing research on an enemy, subsequent scans will reveal their weak points.
descriptions.zh: 在对敌人完成研究后，后续扫描将暴露出他们的弱点。

descriptions.en: Fires a small burst of lasers.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BURST LASER）点射一小束激光。

descriptions.en: Allows the Helios Prime to violently disassemble and turn itself into a deadly projectile.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR PRIME）使赫利俄斯 Prime 剧烈拆卸，并将自身变化为一颗致命的发射体。

descriptions.en: Standard issue weaponry signature to Dethcube.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DETH MACHINE RIFLE）死亡魔方标准武器

descriptions.en: Freeze targets in their tracks with this sentinel mounted ice-beam.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ARTAX）使用守护装有的冰冷光束将目标在行动路线上冻结。

descriptions.en: A laser rifle developed by reverse-engineering Corpus technology.
descriptions.zh: （英文：LASER RIFLE）通过 Corpus 科技逆向工程开发出来的一种激光步枪。

descriptions.en: Shade Prime’s signature weapon fires laser bursts.
descriptions.zh: 阴影 Prime 的标志性武器会发射激光束。

descriptions.en: Signature default weapon of Dethcube Prime.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DETH MACHINE RIFLE PRIME）死亡魔方 Prime 的标志性武器。

descriptions.en: A Prime Laser Rifle.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRIME LASER RIFLE）一把激光步枪 Prime。

descriptions.en: Standard issue weapon for Carrier Prime Sentinel. Fires shotgun rounds.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SWEEPER PRIME）搬运者 PRIME的标准武器，使用霰弹枪子弹。

descriptions.en: Fires a small burst of lasers.
descriptions.zh: （英文：PRISMA BURST LASER）点射一小束激光。

descriptions.en: Standard issue weapon for Djinn Sentinel. Fires <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin projectiles that embed into enemies and continuously deal damage for 3 seconds.
descriptions.zh: （英文：STINGER）引灵守护的标准武器。发射 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素投射物，嵌入敌人体内并持续造成伤害，持续 3 秒。

descriptions.en: Standard issue sniper rifle for Diriga.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VULKLOK）电气浮囊的标准狙击枪。

descriptions.en: Causes the Helios Sentinel to attack enemy targets using pieces of itself.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR）赫利俄斯用自己身上的部件攻击目标敌人。

descriptions.en: Standard issue weapon for Carrier Sentinel. Fires shotgun rounds.
descriptions.zh: （英文：SWEEPER）搬运者守护的标准武器，使用霰弹枪子弹。

descriptions.en: The icy signature weapon of Nautilus Prime.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VERGLAS PRIME）鹦鹉螺 Prime 的标志性冰冻武器。

descriptions.en: Designed as the perfect mate for Nautilus, this Sentinel weapon projects an icy beam at nearby targets.
descriptions.zh: 作为鹦鹉螺的完美同伴，这件守护武器可向附近的目标投射冰冻光束。

descriptions.en: Critical hits cause flowers to grow from the wounds.
descriptions.zh: 暴击伤害会使伤口中长出花朵。

descriptions.en: Enables Tennokai.
descriptions.zh: 启用 Tenno 气解。

descriptions.en: Fatal strikes against an enemy also perform a Codex Scan. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
descriptions.zh: 对一个敌人致死攻击同时也会进行资料库扫描。扫描需要携带一个资料库扫描器且有可用的扫描次数。

descriptions.zh: 在近战武器上附加<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害

descriptions.en:
To cosmic forms from tangent planes

We end as we began
descriptions.zh:
对于从相切位面演化出的宇宙来说

我们的结局又回到了开始

descriptions.en:
In luminous space blackened stars

They gaze, accuse, deny
descriptions.zh:
光明的太空之中，飘荡着焦黑的星辰

它们凝视、指责、否认

descriptions.en:
To cosmic madness laws submit

Though stalwart minds entreat
descriptions.zh:
面对疯狂的宇宙，法则选择了屈服

但那些坚定之人却前去乞求

descriptions.en:
From brooding gulfs are we beheld

By that which bears no name
descriptions.zh:
来自沉思之渊的视线，落在了我们身上

其源头为无名之物

descriptions.en:
Carrion hordes trill their profane

Accord with eldritch plans
descriptions.zh:
腐朽的大军以亵渎的口吻

吟唱着古老的计划

descriptions.en:
Roiling, moaning, this realm of ours

In madness lost shall die
descriptions.zh:
我们的世界，沸腾着，呻吟着

在癫狂之中，等待迷失者的只有死亡

descriptions.en:
Corporeal laws are unwrit

As suns and love retreat
descriptions.zh:
定律归零

太阳和爱退缩

descriptions.en:
Its heralds are the stars it fells

The sky and Earth aflame
descriptions.zh:
掉落的星辰是它到来的先兆

天地燃烧

descriptions.en:
Through endless faces, countless forms, a multitude unfolds.

(Mimics any Requiem Mod)
descriptions.zh:
通过无尽的面孔、无数的形态，呈现出千姿百态。

（可模拟任意安魂 Mod）
